protocol.timingBoundary: First source-chunk request through final CPU-readable PCM; excludes initialization, validation, hashing, WAV encoding and save. Optional articleCallPeakRssBytes spans the entire browser call including post-timer validation/export. Generation RSS uses timestamped samples inside browser generation start/end boundaries; it includes the owned Chrome process tree and browser baseline.

environment.machineLabel: MacBook Pro (Apple M1 Pro, 16 GB, native arm64; macOS 26.6.2)

support.scope: Pinned ZONOS3-Mini checkpoint and official 27-preset voice catalog; one English preset is staged and benchmarked.
support.notes: The checkpoint advertises 43 languages across 44 server locale codes and the pinned voice manifest lists 27 presets, including 10 English voices. Only Imogen (English, British female) is staged and measured. The WebGPU profile loads its reference codes and speaker embedding; the CPU/WASM profile loads the speaker embedding only. The benchmark skips unused preview audio. No other preset or language is exercised.

cells.precision: audio.cpp Q4_0 routed experts / Q8_0 GDN and attention projections; remaining tensors F16/F32

settings.voicePreviewAudio: CPU TTS uses only the pinned Imogen speaker embedding; reference codes and preview audio are not loaded.
settings.textFrontend: audio.cpp community ZONOS3 tokenizer; canonical text spans are passed unchanged with normalization disabled.
settings.decoder: KEEP-2 via pinned zac-keep2.gguf (audio.cpp selects it from the model package)
settings.streamDecode: Offline audio.cpp generation; the complete canonical span is returned before first PCM.
settings.shortText: Not implemented by this community CPU port; canonical spans are passed unchanged.
settings.output: Mono 44.1 kHz Float32 PCM; offline audio.cpp API returns a full canonical span before its first-PCM event.
settings.assetCache: Pinned same-origin GGUF files stored as 16 MiB CacheStorage ranges keyed by SHA-256, then copied to Emscripten MEMFS.

capability.description: CPU/WASM probe returned finite 44.1 kHz mono PCM; the runtime contains no GPU backend.

notes: Capability checks run separately before timing. GPU dispatch does not imply GPU-exclusive execution.
Raw WAV is saved locally; opt-in audio publication is separate from timing and automatic result submission.
AC power; Chrome 157.0.8103.40; one-thread v3 CPU/WASM; serialized shared M1 queue.

RSS is sampled every 500 ms across the owned Chrome process tree, including the Chrome baseline and inference workers. Whole-call peak spans post-timer validation/export; generation mean uses only in-window samples from browser generation start through final CPU-readable PCM.
